comparison.objective: Clear loose cups while detecting and leaving one force-retained cup; candidate adjusts a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Gentle probing to distinguish breakaway resistance, then cup transport; candidate instead counterholds, loosens, rotates, tightens, and evaluates impacts.
comparison.success_condition: Both loose cups upright in tray; zero if stuck cup moves over 3 mm, tips, or falls. No indexed spec version.
comparison.reason: Both require force sensitivity, but one tests nondestructive property probing while the other tests tunable mechanism commissioning.
